part_name: AM59 cold-wall outdoor enclosure V2 - welded tub
assumptions: The AM59 is procured in the modular (heatsink-less) configuration the datasheet offers for OEM integration; its conduction base is assumed flat at the native fin-root plane. The exact base flatness, screw pattern, and approved TIM are vendor gates.

The exact vendor STEP is split by native-Y solid grouping (threshold 235 mm) into a 29-solid chassis group placed inside the dry volume and a 51-solid fin/plate/fan group re-registered below the cold floor as the reference layout for a released OEM-equivalent heat sink.

The heat-sink-to-air resistance of 0.105 K/W is an engineering estimate from OEM fin geometry and installed-flow assumptions, consistent with the vendor's 70 C case rating; calorimetric confirmation is a release gate.

The internal heat budget is 65 W design / 90 W maximum-gate (25/50 W future DIN, 25 W net solar, 15 W amplifier leakage); the 125/200 W amplifier dissipation crosses the cold floor and never loads the cabin air.
A max_interference allowance of 0.5 mm3 tolerates coincident contact faces and CAD-kernel noise, not physical overlap.
Connector ports, RF feedthroughs, the pressure vent, mast adapter, and rotator mounting are deliberately absent from this revision.
unresolved: Microwave Amps must confirm the modular variant interface (base flatness, fixing pattern, TIM, warranty) and approve flange-edge clamping and the mast vibration environment.
The relocated OEM-equivalent fin/fan stack must be released against vendor fan curves and verified by calorimetry; fan environmental rating in the hooded wet zone is unconfirmed.
A pressure-equalization vent (deferred by requirement) is mandatory before sealed IP66 qualification; sealed-volume breathing otherwise produces multi-kPa differentials.
Lid gasket gland, rim inserts, clamp preload, shear restraint, and bond/ground scheme require selected-hardware data and structural release.
Complete-assembly IP6X/IPX6, thermal, condensation, salt-fog, vibration, and EMC qualification remain open.
